summary: Full E2E test of KEP PhysicsVerse (Mechanics MVP): backend 31/31 pytest passed (auth, content, practice, notes CRUD, lab reports, analytics, teacher gating, Claude SSE tutor, lab viva AI). Frontend all critical flows verified end-to-end via Playwright on the public preview URL: login (student + teacher), dashboard, practice with feedback, notes create, projectile sim canvas + play + graph series, Graph Studio + Export CSV, Analytics charts, Virtual Lab experiment picker + next step, Teacher Studio class analytics for teacher role (student sees restricted UI + 403 network). Primary AI feature (Claude Sonnet 4.6 tutor) validated with real arithmetic probe '12+30 = 42' — model answered '42' streamed via SSE and rendered in chat. Lab Viva AI probed via backend — returned pendulum-relevant text (>40 chars, mentions pendulum/length/gravity).
ai_feature_verdicts: AI Tutor (Claude Sonnet 4.6 via emergentintegrations, SSE) - pass - evidence: POST /api/tutor/chat streamed deltas that assembled to '42' for prompt '17+26', UI probe '12+30' rendered '42' in chat-message-assistant. Frontend and backend both exercised. skill: ai-testing-llm
Lab Viva AI (Claude Sonnet 4.6) - pass - evidence: POST /api/lab/viva/exp-pendulum-g returned viva text >40 chars containing pendulum/length/gravity references. skill: ai-testing-llm

issues: Recharts prints 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings during initial mount because ResponsiveContainer measures a hidden/zero-height parent on first paint. Charts DO render correctly afterwards; only console noise. Consider setting min-height on chart container to suppress.

action_items: (Optional) Silence Recharts width(-1) warnings by giving chart containers an explicit min-height so ResponsiveContainer never measures 0.
(Nit) The 2 console 401 errors during the login page mount come from GET /api/auth/me being called before the token is present — harmless but noisy; could gate the call on token presence.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py sets cookie with samesite='none' + secure=True — correct for cross-site preview; requires HTTPS which the preview provides. Good.
seed_admin idempotently updates password if changed (line 450-452). Matches auth playbook requirement.
bcrypt used correctly (hashpw + checkpw with UTF-8 encode). Hashes start with $2b$.
get_current_user reads token from cookie OR Bearer header — dual-mode auth supported and both are exercised by tests.
SSE endpoint properly saves user message BEFORE stream and assistant message AFTER stream completes; error path yields an error delta into the stream so the UI never freezes silently.
Practice submit strips answer/solution/tolerance from GET responses — prevents answer leakage.
Analytics teacher gating enforced server-side (403 for non-teacher). Verified.
MongoDB _id excluded from all list responses via projection {"_id": 0} — no ObjectId serialization issues.
CORS: allow_origins uses env FRONTEND_URL + localhost:3000; allow_credentials=True — correct for cookie auth.
server.py is 465 lines — under the 700 threshold but growing; consider splitting routers if more features are added.
test_credentials: student@physicsverse.com / Physics@123 (student), admin@physicsverse.com / Physics@123 (teacher) — both verified working. Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Registration tests create TEST_stu_* / TEST_tea_* users (not cleaned up; low-volume, prefix-tagged). Notes test creates and deletes its own note. Lab report test creates one report (not deleted — schema has no per-report delete endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Mechanics MVP features on backend + frontend are green. AI integration via emergentintegrations LlmChat with claude-sonnet-4-6 works both in streaming (tutor) and non-streaming (lab viva) modes. If the AI features stop working, first check EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in /app/backend/.env and the backend logs for 401/402/quota. Pytest command: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v.
